core_obligations: Reduce to a presentation: a subset of the space of the stack is locally closed and constructible exactly when its preimage in a smooth presentation is, and openness descends along the open surjective map from the presentation (proof lines 2232-2240)

Apply the scheme case: in a Noetherian scheme a constructible subset that is locally closed is open, so the preimage is open, and the image of an open subset under the open surjective map from the presentation is open, giving openness of the original subset (proof lines 2241-2249)
proof_roadmap: 取概型 U → X 满光滑（U Noetherian） ⇒ |U| → |X| 开且满。
局部闭 + 可构造性沿满光滑展示等价，且开性沿开满射下降。
概型层面：Noetherian 概型中可构造的局部闭子集是开的 ⇒ 原集合开。
